## A better menopause experience awaits.

![Icon showing 2 people next to each other](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/iconCare.svg)

**Care**

Meet via telemedicine with a board-certified clinician for prescriptions, labs & more.

![Icon showing a piece of paper](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/iconEducation.svg)

**Education**

Access evidence-based readings & recs on top menopause symptoms (sleep, sex, hot flashes & more).

![Icon showing a conversation chat bubble](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/iconConversation.svg)

**Support**

Get paired 1:1 with your Elektra Coach to ask questions & build a personalized wellness plan.

![Icon showing 3 hands](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Community-icon.svg)

**Community**

Join virtual events with menopause experts, participate in discussions & get inspired.

## Elektra for organizations

1/5 women consider leaving their job due to menopause, with menopause-related productivity losses costing companies $810 billion a year. Join **Mass General Brigham Health Plan, EmblemHealth, Reddit, LVMH,** and other leading organizations supporting women in the workplace at every stage of life.

[Learn more](https://www.elektrahealth.com/for-employers/)

### Sign up for evidence-based menopause care & support

Because knowledge is power. And because living well is your right.

- **Meet with a board-certified clinician** for labs & prescriptions as needed
- **Enjoy ongoing support & follow-up visits** with your care team (clinician & coach)
- **Access educational content,** plus virtual events & a private community

[Get started](https://hub.elektrahealth.com/get-started?utm_source=homepage&utm_medium=site)

![Smiling mature woman looking at her smartphone. Wearing a yellow collared shirt.](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/iStock-1402814088-1.jpg)

## Real women, real stories

Speaking up and out is the first step to changing the menopause narrative.
We love highlighting our community members' stories, showing us there's nothing "one-size-fits-all" about menopause.

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Trish.png)

TRISH S. \| Elektra Patient

### "In my career, I have banged my head on many a glass ceiling to be heard, and this just feels like another thing that we have to demand for ourselves and advocate for the generations coming."

[Read Trish's story](https://www.elektrahealth.com/blog/taboosmasher-trish-solsaa/)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Omisade-Image.png)

OMISADE B. \| Community Member

### "Menopause is a transformative experience. It's transformed the way I relate to my body, which transforms my work relationships, my friendships, and my romantic relationships."

[Read Omisade's story](https://www.elektrahealth.com/blog/real-talk/taboosmasher-spotlight-omisade-burney-scott-creator-of-the-black-girls-guide-to-surviving-menopause/)

Ready to join our movement to smash the menopause taboo? We'd love to hear your story!

[Share my story](https://www.elektrahealth.com/share-my-story/)

## Smashing the taboo starts with science.

Elektra patients get assigned a care team with a board-certified clinician AND a coach for ongoing care and support.

![Amarily Barahona](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-626-1.png)

#### Amarily Barahona

DNP, CNM, APRN, C-EFM

Amarily Barahona is a Certified Nurse Midwife and Doctor of Nursing Practice with over a decade of experience. She believes strongly that every patient deserves individualized care, and is committed to educating patients so they feel empowered to make informed decisions and confidently advocate for their own health. She attended Frontier Nursing University for her midwifery and doctoral degrees. When not working, Amarily can be found spending time with her 7 kiddos (blended family!) and 2 fur babies — or daydreaming about anything space/NASA-related.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#amarily-barahona)

![Kimberly Phelps](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/KGP-Headshot-2-1.png)

#### Kimberly Phelps

FNP-BC, MSCP

Kimberly Phelps is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner who is also certified by The Menopause Society. She believes in blending evidence-based medicine with compassionate care to promote a grounded, transformative health journey. Kimberly earned her bachelors from Johns Hopkins University, followed by a masters from New York University. She has previously worked at One Medical and Galileo Health, and has been an adjunct faculty member at NYU College of Nursing. She has 3 grown children, along with 3 dogs and 3 cats. Fun fact: she lived in the UK for 25 years!

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#kimberly-phelps)

![Muni Tahzib](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Muni-Headshot-1.png)

#### Muni Tahzib

MD

Muni Tahzib is a board-certified physician. After years spent providing care as an allergist-immunologist, she shifted her focus to women’s health. She believes that true healing is possible when a clinician addresses the body-mind-soul connection, which is what led her to become a certified mindfulness and meditation teacher. Muni received her medical degree in the Netherlands, with subsequent training at Albert Einstein College of Medicine. For the past 16 years, she’s led humanitarian medical relief trips around the world. She has 3 adult children and, in her free time, loves to paint, play the piano, and be in nature.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#muni-tahzib)

![Nora Lansen](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Nora-Lansen.1.jpg)

#### Nora Lansen

MA, MD, MSCP

Nora Lansen is a primary care physician with a breadth of experience in healthcare and leadership. After completing her family medicine residency at the Institute for Family Health / Beth Israel (NY), Nora joined One Medical, where she focused on primary care, people leadership, and the design and implementation of reproductive health services. Nora then moved on to lead the digital clinical team at Galileo Health, overseeing the growth of the team from five to one hundred fifty clinicians, with a focus on delivering high quality, accessible healthcare in the virtual space. Nora earned her BA from Johns Hopkins and MD from New York Medical College. Previously a lifelong New Yorker, she moved to Seattle with her three kids (and rescue dog, Luke) in 2022 and is still adjusting to the overwhelming beauty and soundtrack of the Pacific Northwest (silence, not sirens).

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#nora-lansen)

![Photo of a middle-aged woman with short brown hair and a soft smile](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Gail-DeLasho.jpg)

#### Gail DeLasho

MD, FACOG, MSCP

Gail DeLasho brings decades of experience in obstetrics and gynecology. She trained at Boston University Medical Center, after which she moved to New York, where she has been practicing ever since. Dr. DeLasho is a Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner and has been a member of The Menopause Society since 1994. She is also a member of the International Society for the Study of Women's Sexual Health (ISSWSH), the International Society for Sexual Medicine (ISSM), and the International Society for the Study of Vulvovaginal Disease (ISSVD).

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#gail-delasho)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/DP.png)

#### Dineasha Potter-McQuilkin

MD, FACOG, MSCP

Dineasha Potter-McQuilkin is a double board-certified OB/GYN and Lifestyle Medicine physician, as well as a Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner. Passionate about midlife women's wellness, she combines expertise with compassion to empower women during this transformative life stage.

She earned her medical degree from St. George’s University School of Medicine and completed her residency at St. Peter’s University Hospital/Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School Program. Outside of work, Dr. Potter-McQuilkin enjoys hiking, reading, and cherishing moments with her husband and three children. She earned her medical degree from St. George's University School of Medicine and completed her residency at St. Peter's University Hospital/Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School Program. Outside of work, Dr. Potter-McQuilkin enjoys hiking, reading, and cherishing moments with her husband and three children.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#dineasha-potter-mcquilkin)

#### Yvette Sims

FNP-C, MSCP

Yvette Sims is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner certified by The Menopause Society. She's been in practice for over 20 years and remains committed to providing personalized, compassionate care to guide women towards optimal health and wellness. She earned her Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Binghamton University and Master of Science in Nursing as a Family Nurse Practitioner from Pace University in Manhattan. In her free time, Yvette enjoys practicing yoga and spending time with her two sons.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#yvette-sims)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/KG-1.png)

#### Kara Govoni

CNM, MSCP

Kara Govoni is a Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM) and Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner who is also currently working towards an AASECT certification as a Sexuality Counselor. She has worked as a full-scope CNM for the past 13 years in both obstetrics and gynecology but over the past five years has honed her speciality to sexual health and midlife care, as she feels an increasing passion to help women during some of the most vulnerable — but least-talked-about — times in their lives. Kara earned her Bachelors from Eastern Nazarene College and masters degree in nurse midwifery from The Ohio State University. She currently resides in Massachusetts with her four children. Fun fact: she’s also a professional organizer in her free time!

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#kara-govoni)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/DB.png)

#### Dawn Black

APRN, WHNP-BC, MSCP

Dawn Black is a board-certified Women's Health Nurse Practitioner with over 30 years of experience in caring for women in the United States Air Force. She earned her Bachelor and Master of Science in Nursing from the University of Florida and is a Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner (MSCP). Dawn practices personalized care where women feel heard and respected, ensuring their unique needs and concerns are addressed. When she's not working, you can find Dawn spending time with family (her spouse, two children, and three Pomeranians!), traveling, reading, or exercising.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#dawn-black)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Melody-Circle-1.png)

#### Melody Lin

WHNP, MSCP

Melody Lin is a board-certified Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner who is also certified by The Menopause Society. She loves enabling her patients to take charge of their own health, and is a strong advocate for the LGBTQ community. She attended nursing school at The University of Texas at Arlington, and graduate school at Texas Women’s University. Prior to Elektra, she worked at Planned Parenthood and FOLX Health. In her spare time, Melody loves traveling with her husband, running (she’s run a marathon!), and spending time with her 2 dogs and 2 cats. Fun fact: she’s fostered over 30 kittens for a cat rescue!

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#melody-lin)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Rewa-Circle-1.png)

#### Rewa Thompson

DNP, WHNP-BC

Rewa Thompson is a board-certified Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner and Doctor of Nursing Practice. Her extensive background in women’s health includes 30 years working at Planned Parenthood of Greater New York, where she specialized in reproductive care services. She believes that all patients should be well-informed so that they can make the best decisions regarding their care. She earned her bachelor’s degree from Adelphi University before attending graduate school at Stony Brook University for her masters and doctoral degrees. When she’s not working, Rewa enjoys spending time at the gym doing aqua aerobics and zumba, serving as a deaconess at her church, and traveling with her husband and daughters. She’s the proud grandma of a 4-year-old Jack Russell Terrier rescue dog!

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#rewa-thompson)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Carol-DerSarkissian.png)

#### Carol DerSarkissian

MD, MSCP

Carol DerSarkissian is a board-certified physician and Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner. She has worked as a Clinical Assistant Professor at NYU Langone Medical Center, and as an Attending Physician at Manhattan VA Hospital. Her approach to midlife care is interconnected, blending traditional medicine, innovation, and compassion with the goal of empowering women to embrace this phase with strength and confidence. She earned her bachelors and medical degrees from University of Southern California before completing her residency at NYU Medical School/Bellevue Hospital. She’s a mom of two and, in her free time, enjoys metal sculpting, hiking and swimming in the ocean.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#carol-dersarkissian)

![Lindsay Athans](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Lindsay.png)

#### Lindsay Athans

FNP, MSCP

Lindsay Athans is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner who is also certified by The Menopause Society. She has experience in women’s health, primary care, and oncology and has also worked as a personal trainer and group fitness instructor. Her clinical philosophy centers around treatment of the whole person, and she enjoys developing long-term, trusting relationships with patients. She earned a bachelors degree in Human Services from Northeastern University, and a bachelors of science in nursing from Down State University Medical Center. Lindsay then went on to obtain her masters and nurse practitioner degree from Stony Brook University. She lives in New York State with her husband and two children, and enjoys running, biking, strength training, reading, dancing, music, and baking!

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#lindsay-athans)

![](https://www.elektrahealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Jenn.png)

#### Jennifer Malamas

MD, MSCP

Jennifer Malamas is a board-certified physician and Menopause Society-Certified Practitioner. For Jenn, delivering the best quality care is founded upon a comprehensive approach that includes open and effective communication, patient education, and advocacy. To achieve these ends, she has also completed Leadership Coaching certification and MMTCP Meditation teacher training, maintaining an active practice as a women's leadership coach as well as a meditation teacher. Jenn's combined skills foster the best possible outcomes for patient's lives and health. Jenn earned her medical degree from Howard University and trained as a resident at St. Luke’s-Roosevelt/Mount Sinai in NYC. She currently lives in the Pocono Mountains and in her free time enjoys being active and spending time outside (yoga, kayaking, hiking, birding), organizing, spending time with her husband and step-daughter, and hosting friends.

[Click for full bio](https://www.elektrahealth.com/#jennifer-malamas)

CNM

Julia Fritz is a Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM). After years spent providing care in obstetrics, she expanded her focus to incorporate more comprehensive women’s health, including peri/menopause care. Julia practices whole-person, evidence-based care that starts with listening. Julia earned her bachelors in nursing from Colorado State University, followed by a masters from Frontier Nursing University. She hails from the lakes of Minnesota and now lives in the heart of the Rocky Mountains. In her free time, Julia loves playing in the mountains and sharing adventures with her family.
